newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Lone Star buys 100 pct of Awak Mas.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Lone Star buys 100 pct of Awak Mas.

text.p: Lone Star Exploration NL said on Thursday it had bought out its partners in the Awak Mas gold project in Indonesia for a total of about US$41 million (A$50.6 million).
Lone Star, which is listed in Australia and Canada, said it would acquire the 45 per cent interest of Gascoyne Gold Mines NL and the 10 per cent stake held by South African mining house JCI Ltd.
Lone Star would pay Gasgoyne US$15 million on settlement, US$20 million over three years and issue Gascoyne 10 million ordinary shares in Lone Star.
The consideration came to about $US41 million.
It had also agreed to purchase JCI's free-carried 10 per cent stake for a consideration of 25 million shares in Lone Star.
As part of the agreement, JCI would assist Lone Star by sourcing US$20 million of non-recourse funding for the Awak Mas mine development, on Sulawesi Island.
Lone Star chairman Robert Wilde said the acquisition would be externally funded and Lone Star would not require further shareholder capital in the immediate future.
The agreement was an indication of the company's confidence that Awak Mas, which has a current resource of 2.7 million ounces, would become one of Indonesia's major gold producing regions, he said.
